Won by NIYAT · Raghav Sethi Process Hackathon process 01 20 July 2099, 12:00 AM IST Hackathon begins The online build and validation phase begins. 02 31 July 2099, 11:59 PM IST Registration closes The registration form closes automatically at the IST deadline. 03 1 August 2099, 12:00 AM IST Submissions open The submission form opens for registered teams. 04 7 August 2099, 11:59 PM IST Submission deadline Submit a TestFlight build or working screen-recording demonstration. 05 8–10 August 2099 Evaluation and finalist announcement Submissions are evaluated after the deadline. Results are announced by email on 10 August. 06 22 August 2099 Bengaluru finale Finalists present live. Venue coming soon; teams arrange travel and accommodation.
